purpose: decide whether a specific build is ready to go to production, using recorded evidence rather than opinion
entry_criteria: Release candidate build exists with an immutable id
Test, security and migration stages for the scope have results
Release manager is not the sole implementer
procedure: List every change in the release and link to its evidence.
Check each required gate has a PASS with a commit and command, or an approved waiver.
Review open defects and exceptions; each must be accepted by its owner.
Confirm rollback plan, monitoring and on-call coverage exist for the release window.
Record GO, NO-GO or CONDITIONAL with reasons and send to change approval (stage 129).
acceptance_criteria: Every required gate has evidence or an approved waiver
Decision is recorded with its reasons
validation_method: Go/no-go reviewed in the change approval step.

validation.command: python3 scripts/check_references.py && python3 scripts/validate.py   # repository integrity if the release includes registry changes

validation.check: open each evidence link and confirm it names the release candidate id
validation.expect: all links resolve and match the candidate id

failure_modes.mode: Evidence belongs to a different build
failure_modes.detection: Commit in evidence differs from candidate
failure_modes.response: Treat as missing evidence; NO-GO until rerun

failure_modes.mode: Readiness decided in a meeting without a record

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: All gates pass except a medium accessibility defect with an owner and fix date. The decision is CONDITIONAL: ship, with the fix tracked in the next release.
